author: Bill Ferguson
name: apply_camera_style
description: Applies the darktable style that corresponds to the camera that took each image, matching the camera's straight-out-of-camera JPEG look.
description-extensive: This automatically gives your raw photos a starting look similar to the JPEG your camera would have produced, based on which camera model took each shot. It saves time by applying a matching camera style so you have a familiar baseline before you begin editing. No extra software is needed.
